synthetic_note: No market or fund numbers in this body. Portfolio weights and thresholds, where present, are fictional-scenario values invented by the team; persona facts quote the official case.
description: Ambiguous language ('maximum growth and strict diversification') yields a clarification question, never a contradiction verdict.

request_headers.Authorization: Bearer <access code typed by the user>

request_body.text: I want maximum growth and strict diversification.

response_body.original_words: I want maximum growth and strict diversification.

unsupported.reason: No rule type measures growth, and the tool does not forecast returns. It is kept as a qualitative objective.

clarifications.question: The two wishes can pull in different directions, but that is not a proven contradiction. What should 'strict diversification' mean as a rule you can check?

options.label: A maximum share of the portfolio in any single company
options.description: Counts direct holdings and holdings through equity funds. You choose the number.

proposed_rule.scope_description: Maximum total equity exposure to any single company: direct holdings plus look-through via equity funds, share classes of one company added together. Bond funds, commodity funds and crypto assets are outside this rule's scope and are not assessed.

options.label: A maximum share in any single sector
options.description: Not supported yet: there is no sector-cap rule type in this version.

options.label: Keep it as a qualitative preference only
options.description: Nothing will be checked numerically for it; it stays visible as context.
